# Select — M3 guidance

<!-- Generated by apps/site/scripts/one-off/migrate-guidance.mjs. Do not edit by hand.
     The component pages carry the reference; this file carries the guidance. -->

## Web

### Features

Reach for a select when the answer is one of a known set and the set is too long to lay out — countries, timezones, a parent record. It shows the current choice on the trigger and the rest only on demand, which is what makes it compact. If the set is short enough to read at a glance, a radio group is better: a select hides the alternatives, and someone cannot choose what they have not seen. If the answer is several values, that is a checkbox group or a multi-select, not this.

### Usage

**Do**

- Use for choosing one value from a fixed list — 6+ options or tight space where radios won't fit.
- Mirror the text-field treatment: filled on lower surfaces, outlined everywhere else.
- Mark mandatory selects `required`.

**Don't**

- Don't use for 2–5 always-visible choices — that is a radio group or segmented button.
- Don't use for free text — that is an input or combobox.

### Tokens

| Element | State | Token | Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Filled container | resting | comp.filled-select.text-field-container-color | --sys-color-surface-container-highest, 4px top |
| Outlined container | resting | comp.outlined-select.text-field-container-shape | corner-extra-small 4px, 1px outline |
| Menu surface | resting | comp.menu.container-color | surface, level2 shadow |

### Anatomy

| Part | Role |
| --- | --- |
| SelectRoot | Owns the open state and the selected value. Generic over the value type, so a select of numbers stays numbers. |
| SelectTrigger | The closed control showing the current choice. Opens the list. |
| SelectValue | Renders the selected value inside the trigger. |
| SelectContent | The list surface. Portals to the end of the document and positions itself against the trigger. |
| SelectItem | One option. |
| SelectItemText | The option's label text. |
| SelectItemIndicator | The selected mark inside an option. Renders only while its option is selected. |
| SelectGroupLabel | A heading for a run of related options. |
| SelectSeparator | A divider between runs of options. |
| Select | The namespace object: all of the parts above. |

### Deviations from Material 3

**K6** — spec: M3's component elevation table does not name a select. It tabulates "menu" at resting level 2, and kern maps that row to `navigation-menu`, so there is no spec row a select could conform to.

Kern: The select popup rests at elevation level 2, matching the menu row's level.

Why: The open list behaves as an overlay above the page, so it needs the same lift a menu has — but claiming the menu row would assert something M3 never said about selects. The level is registered as K6 in m3-elevation.ts so the choice is a recorded decision rather than an incidental value in a stylesheet.

### FAQ

**Select, combobox, or autocomplete?**

Select for a fixed closed list. Combobox when the list filters as you type. Autocomplete when suggestions complete free text.

## Native

### Features

Reach for a select when the answer is one value from a known set and the alternatives fit a short list: a category, a sort order, a country. Options are data — `value` and `label` — so the list is a declaration. The selection is controlled or uncontrolled and reports the chosen VALUE rather than an event, which is what makes it easy to store. Note `onDismiss`: the surface that opens for the choice reports when it goes away without a selection, so you can tell a pick from a bail-out.

### Usage

**Do**

- Declare options as data and let the selected option read back into the field — the field is the summary, the menu is the choice.
- Keep a real placeholder so the unchosen state says what the field is for.
- Prefer `Select` over a free text field when the answer must come from a fixed set.

**Don't**

- Don't use a select for two or three options that fit on screen — radio or chips show the set without hiding it.
- Don't duplicate the selected value as a separate label elsewhere on the screen.

### Tokens

| Element | State | Token | Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Field | resting | theme.color.surface | surface, outline border, minHeight 56 |
| Placeholder | resting | theme.color.onSurfaceVariant | onSurfaceVariant until an option is chosen |
| Selected option | selected | theme.color.surfaceTonal | surfaceTonal wash behind the chosen row |
| Disabled field | disabled | opacity 0.38 | whole trigger dims to 38% |

### Deviations from Material 3

**K6** — spec: M3's component elevation table does not name a select. It tabulates "menu" at resting level 2, and kern maps that row to `navigation-menu`, so there is no spec row a select could conform to.

Kern: The select popup rests at elevation level 2, matching the menu row's level.

Why: The open list behaves as an overlay above the page, so it needs the same lift a menu has — but claiming the menu row would assert something M3 never said about selects. Registered as K6 in the elevation inventory so the level is a recorded decision rather than an incidental value in a stylesheet.

### FAQ

**Select or dropdown menu?**

Select owns a field that keeps the chosen value visible; a menu hangs its choice off a trigger and reports through callbacks. A value that must stay on screen means select.

**How does this differ from the web select?**

The contract is the same (options as data, controlled or uncontrolled). The options render in a native modal with a scrim rather than a positioned listbox, and the selected row carries a tonal wash.
